content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

This infrastructure is designed for resilience. Conventional platforms impose fees and restrictions that can cripple your earnings. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can significantly impact your revenue. In contrast, by using NOWPayments with COREMERCH, you only incur a 0.5% fee. This difference means that on 100 sales of a $97 product, you could retain an extra $921. This is not just cost-effective; it's a pathway to greater financial independence.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign commerce stack, ensure you have essential tools in place. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a Google account for Apps Script or Sheets, and your choice of cryptocurrency for transactions. Familiarize yourself with NOWPayments for automatic payment processing. Understanding these tools and how they integrate is critical to establishing a robust digital storefront that operates independently of traditional platforms.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by configuring NOWPayments to accept your preferred cryptocurrencies. Integrate it with your backend logic, which could be via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This setup allows for instant payment confirmation and automated delivery of digital products. Ensure your products are listed and ready for delivery through secure file storage like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This streamlined process not only simplifies transactions but also reinforces your financial sovereignty.
Take control of your sales process and eliminate third-party fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Share your product links on social media and relevant platforms to attract buyers. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments system will verify the transaction on-chain, and your digital product will be automatically delivered. Monitor the first few transactions to ensure that everything operates smoothly, allowing you to address any potential issues quickly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your infrastructure operational, focus on scaling. You can expand your product offerings beyond ebooks and courses to include templates, plugins, and more. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, which will help you enhance and streamline your digital store. Collect data from your sales to identify trends and adjust your strategy for maximum profitability and growth.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, set up your own digital commerce infrastructure using tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments. This allows you to process payments in cryptocurrency directly, avoiding the high fees and restrictions of traditional platforms. You maintain complete control over your sales and customer data.
Automated delivery means you can focus on creating more products.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can create your own storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare, integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to maintain ownership and control over your sales without relying on conventional payment processors.

Utilize a sovereign stack with NOWPayments for low transaction fees and build your store on free hosting platforms like GitHub or Cloudflare. This approach minimizes costs and maximizes your profit margins.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by setting up your own digital commerce infrastructure with NOWPayments and a hosting service like GitHub Pages, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers without relying on third-party platforms.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept various forms of payment, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins, providing flexibility and options for your customers.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

Set up your delivery system using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery. This ensures that once a payment is confirmed, the digital product is sent to the customer immediately.
